name: INFORSUD Bozouls Data Center
notes: Bozouls/Causse Comtal facility in Aveyron; regional press describes Inforsud's Aveyron data center and hosted/saved data at Bozouls. Capacity not disclosed in MW.

name: UltraEdge Strasbourg Magasin Vauban data center
notes: UltraEdge invested more than EUR15m in its Strasbourg site in the former Magasin Vauban, adding 1 MW and bringing available capacity to 3 MW; six interconnected Bas-Rhin locations are referenced.

name: AETHER Strasbourg AI Gigafactory dual-campus project
notes: Consortium is targeting two Strasbourg-area AI Gigafactory data centers with initial 42 MW capacity and larger long-term ambitions dependent on grid availability; project remains contingent on EU AI Gigafactory process and site development.

name: OVHcloud Strasbourg SBG5
notes: OVHcloud opened SBG5 on its Strasbourg campus after the 2021 fire, describing it as a next-generation resilient and sustainable datacenter. Capacity not stated in MW.

name: OVHcloud Strasbourg Port autonome expansion project
notes: Reported EUR160m-EUR180m Strasbourg expansion on former ArcelorMittal/Port autonome buildings to add cloud data center capacity; no reliable MW figure published.

name: Digital Realty Marseille campus
notes: Digital Realty lists five Marseille data centers with 309k sq ft / 28.8k sq m of colocation space and a large carrier/subsea ecosystem. Aggregate MW not stated on the location page.

name: Digital Realty Marseille MRS3
notes: Interxion announced opening of MRS3 in Marseille with 16.5 MW and about 7,100 sq m of equipped IT space delivered in phases.

name: Digital Realty Marseille MRS4
notes: Digital Realty announced MRS4 at Marseille with up to 13.6 MW customer capacity and direct access to submarine cable systems.

name: Digital Realty Marseille MRS5
notes: Fifth Marseille facility announced for the former sugar silo site at Marseille-Fos Port, offering 22 MW across 12,000 sq m of white space; due-live timing reported as 2026.

name: Digital Realty Marseille MRS6 Bouc-Bel-Air
notes: Digital Realty project page says MRS6 is planned in Bouc-Bel-Air near Marseille with 20,000 sq m of IT space and 50 MW IT capacity; construction expected in 2026 and delivery in 2028. Public consultation/approval evidence also exists.

name: Cagny former Saint Louis Sucre refinery AI data center redevelopment
notes: Former Saint Louis Sucre refinery at Cagny east of Caen is reported as a potential AI data center/high-tech campus redevelopment. Sources describe site size and acquisition talks but no confirmed MW figure.

name: IDLINE Angouleme data center
notes: IDLINE reported capacity and availability upgrades at its Angouleme data center, including additional hosting racks and cooling capacity; no defensible IT MW capacity disclosed.

name: DATA 17 DC01 Saint-Jean-d'Angely
notes: Uptime Institute lists DATA 17 DC01 in Saint-Jean-d'Angely; local and industry sources describe the Charente-Maritime facility as opened in October 2020 and focused on colocation, sovereignty and energy efficiency. Capacity not disclosed in MW.

name: Adista Bourges data center
notes: Adista Bourges data center is listed near Bourges airport and Adista's 2026 CSR magazine includes Bourges among its data centers with PUE/CUE metrics. Capacity not published in MW.

name: ArteOne Datacenter Brive
notes: Artefact describes ArteOne as its Limousin data center based in Brive, Corrèze; France Num also says Artefact relies on the ArteOne data center in Brive. Capacity not disclosed in MW.

name: SITEC Ajaccio data center
notes: SITEC states its hosting infrastructure includes its historic Ajaccio data center plus a newer Bastia data center, interconnected and certified ISO27001/HDS; Ajaccio site is in the Vazzio industrial zone. Capacity not disclosed in MW.
